answer: The cedar lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the ferrous is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, published publicly on failure, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the thread of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
